jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Al Barça som MÉS QUE UN CLUB
perquè tenim un ferm propòsit: volem transformar el món a través de la nostra manera d’entendre l’esport, amb la nostra essència Barça, i amb el nostre compromís social.

Quina és la nostra essència?

Tenim un estil propi... quan juguem volem guanyar, però sobretot volem jugar sense renunciar al nostre estil.
Creiem en les diferents disciplines, per això competim amb 5 esports professionals diferents.
Som un Club format per més de 144.000 socis i sòcies que prenen grans decisions democràticament.
Treballem per garantir la igualtat d’oportunitats, lliures de prejudicis i la no discriminació per raons d'origen, gènere, discapacitat o edat, i fomentem la inclusió de la diversitat de manera equitativa entre totes les persones del nostre entorn.

Què busquem?

L’Àrea de Barça Identity busca incorporar una persona per a la posició de Creative Producer Manager
, amb la missió de liderar la producció integral de campanyes, continguts i projectes especials, assegurant l’excel·lència en l’execució, l’eficiència operativa i la màxima qualitat creativa.
Aquesta persona serà una figura clau per convertir les idees en produccions d’alt impacte, connectant els equips interns amb una sòlida xarxa de partners, talent i proveïdors externs. Busquem un perfil capaç de combinar visió estratègica, criteri creatiu i una gran capacitat d’execució, garantint que cada projecte es desenvolupi amb els estàndards de qualitat, eficiència i innovació que defineixen la marca Barça.

Responsabilitats principals:

Liderar projectes de producció de principi a fi: planificació, pressupost, producció, execució i tancament.
Definir l’estratègia de producció més adequada en funció dels objectius creatius, els terminis i els recursos disponibles.
Gestionar, consolidar i ampliar una xarxa de proveïdors, talent i col·laboradors locals i internacionals.
Negociar pressupostos i assegurar el millor equilibri entre qualitat, cost i terminis d’execució.
Aportar criteri creatiu i sensibilitat visual al llarg de tot el procés de producció.
Supervisar les fases de producció i postproducció, vetllant pel compliment dels estàndards de qualitat.
Coordinar equips interns i partners externs, alineant les necessitats creatives, de negoci i de producció.
Gestionar els pressupostos amb rigor i garantir el compliment dels terminis, processos i objectius establerts.

Perfil Professional:

Entre 8 i 12 anys d’experiència en producció creativa, branded content, publicitat o continguts.
Experiència en productores, agències creatives o equips in-house d’alt nivell.
Coneixement profund de l’ecosistema creatiu de Barcelona i una xarxa consolidada de contactes i proveïdors.
Excel·lents capacitats d’organització, negociació i gestió simultània de múltiples projectes.
Sòlid criteri visual i una alta sensibilitat per la qualitat creativa i l’excel·lència en l’execució.
Capacitat per prendre decisions, treballar en entorns exigents i liderar projectes amb autonomia.
Perfil amb visió estratègica i orientació a l’execució, amb una clara mentalitat hands-on.

Es valorarà especialment:

Experiència en el desenvolupament de campanyes internacionals.
Coneixement del sector de l’entreteniment, els continguts digitals i els formats OOH.
Experiència tant en produccions àgils per a entorns socials i estratègies always-on, mantenint els màxims estàndards de qualitat, com en la gestió de produccions de gran format i alta complexitat.

jobs.title: Senior Social Media and Content Lead
jobs.description:
Senior Social Media & Content Lead | Sarya Holdings

📍 Dubai, UAE | Markets: UAE & Saudi Arabia | Full-time
Sarya Holdings is looking for a senior social media leader to turn a multi-brand food & beverage portfolio into distinctive, culturally relevant and measurable social content across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll own the full social system: strategy, creative direction, team, creators, collaborations, agencies and performance. You'll also stay close enough to the work to write a sharp brief, direct a shoot, improve an edit and explain the numbers behind every decision.

Reporting to: Group Marketing Manager

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Strategy & Multi-Brand Structure

• Set annual and quarterly social strategy for each brand and market, covering audiences, platform roles, content territories and growth targets
• Build distinct UAE and Saudi approaches instead of duplicating one calendar, and adapt language, humour, talent and cultural references
• Design the team's operating model across several brands: roles, ownership, capacity, calendars, approvals and agency support
• Keep the portfolio consistent in quality while protecting each brand's own identity, tone and visual language
• Decide which ideas get hero production, in-house content, creator amplification or paid support
Creative Direction
• Raise the creative bar with social-first ideas, strong hooks, cinematic craft and platform-native pacing
• Write and improve briefs, scripts, captions, shot lists and edit notes, and lead priority shoots end to end
• Build recognisable content series and respond quickly to cultural moments without compromising brand judgement

Platforms, Community & Trends

• Define the role of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and emerging channels
• Track UAE and Saudi cultural signals, competitor activity and platform changes, and turn them into clear actions
• Oversee publishing quality, localisation and community management standards
Creators, UGC & Collaborations
• Build an always-on influencer and UGC pipeline for every priority brand, not just campaign bursts
• Select creators on fit, quality, brand safety, cost and past performance, not follower count alone
• Manage influencer agencies and direct creator relationships, including deliverables, approvals and usage rights
• Originate brand, platform, community, event and cultural collaborations
Paid Social Creative
• Own the creative testing agenda with the performance team or media agency
• Turn creative-level results into concrete decisions on hooks, duration, framing, talent and CTAs
• Create content that drives awareness, retail demand and e-commerce conversion
Team & Agency Leadership
• Structure, lead and coach a team of social media executives, content creators and design/production support
• Run weekly planning, content reviews and post-campaign learning
• Hold agencies, freelancers and production partners accountable for quality, timing and budget
• Partner with brand, performance, e-commerce, retail, sales and customer service teams
Measurement
• Set meaningful KPIs such as qualified reach, watch time, saves, shares, engagement quality, traffic, conversion and creator efficiency
• Deliver concise monthly reports that explain what happened, why it matters and what changes next. No vanity metrics without context.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• 5+ years in social media, content or integrated digital, including at least 2 years leading people, agencies or substantial multi-brand work
• A strong portfolio showing your personal contribution to strategy, creative, production and measurable results
• Proven experience building a team structure, workflow and social content system for more than one brand, audience or market
• Excellent visual judgement, with the ability to tell strong cinematography, art direction, hooks, edits and sound choices apart from content that is merely polished
• Deep knowledge of major platforms, creator ecosystems and audience behaviour, with a track record of anticipating opportunities rather than reacting late
• Experience building an always-on influencer and UGC pipeline and managing agencies (briefs, deliverables, approvals, usage rights, performance evaluation)
• Experience originating and delivering collaborations with brands, platforms, communities, events or cultural partners
• Working knowledge of paid-social creative, testing principles and creative performance metrics
• Strong analytical skills and confidence turning platform, creator and campaign data into decisions
• Clear leadership, feedback and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced environment
• Highly proactive communication and time management: you surface risks early and keep multiple workstreams moving without repeated follow-up
• The curiosity and discipline to understand a brand deeply before proposing its content direction
• Professional fluency in English. Arabic is a strong advantage. Candidates without Arabic must show experience directing Arabic content with native-language reviewers.
• Current knowledge of UAE and Saudi audiences, cultural context and social media behaviour (essential)
• F&B, FMCG, retail, lifestyle, entertainment or another culture-driven consumer category background strongly preferred

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

• Days 1–30: Learn every brand, audit all channels, map team capacity and workflows, and establish baselines
• By Day 60: Present the multi-brand operating model, UAE & KSA social strategy, creator pipeline, collaboration plan and measurement framework
• By Day 90: Run the new planning rhythm, deliver first priority content and creator tests, and share early performance learnings

Screening questions I'd add

"Please share a link to your portfolio (3–5 examples)." Mark this as a must-have so you don't receive CVs without work samples.
"How many years of experience do you have in social media or content roles?" Set the minimum to 5.
"How many years have you led a team, agencies or multi-brand social work?" Set the minimum to 2.
"Do you have professional proficiency in Arabic?" Make this preferred, not mandatory, since non-Arabic speakers can still qualify.
"Are you currently based in the UAE, or willing to relocate to Dubai?"

jobs.description:
Own the AI video pipeline for a $1Billion+ brand. The media is already scaled — the constraint is creative that converts, on the feed and on the page.

Total Annual Package:
Up to AED 22,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
Location:
Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support
Growth path
from here is Senior AI Video Creator → Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023:
In this role, tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Midjourney and Flux are part of the production workflow — not side experiments. AI gets you to footage faster; your judgment decides whether the hook works, the product looks real, the edit holds attention and the finished asset is ready to ship.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Video Creator, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. You will own AI video production across cold-traffic ads on Meta, TikTok and YouTube and product videos on Puffy.com, covering concept and script, image generation, motion, editing, compositing, colour and audio. This role exists to turn already-scaled media spend into creative that converts, building the production pipeline that carries a hook from script to shippable asset at volume without the craft slipping.

The Career Accelerator

You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.

The scope is scarce:
very few AI Video Creators get simultaneous ownership of video creative for both paid advertising and the product page. And a direct line to the Director of Marketing with no layers in between.
Your first 12 months:
build the prompt and reference library for character and material consistency. Produce direct-response ads at volume for Meta and TikTok cold prospecting, multiple concepts per week. Solve character consistency across shots, including AI-generated spokespeople delivering to camera. Produce realism-first product video for Puffy.com from real product photography. Get material behaviour right — foam that compresses under a hand and recovers on release, fabric that moves like fabric. Master the invisible edit, blending generated footage with stock and shot footage until the AI elements are indistinguishable. Read CTR, hold rates and drop-off points and iterate the hook against what audiences actually do. Shape the future of AI video at Puffy, where creative is the binding constraint on a media engine that is already scaled.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI video role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Entire Chain, Script to Shipped Asset

You concept it, generate it, cut it, score it, and ship it.
You design the visual worlds, control the motion, cut for retention, and layer the voiceover, music and sound design — no handoff, no queue, no waiting on someone else's render. You choose which model solves which production problem, and you decide when footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production, and when the right call is to regenerate.
The standard is performance, not applause. Every asset is a hypothesis: with the broader marketing team, you review CTR, hold rates, drop-off points and on-page conversion, iterate the hook, and bring your cuts into review with the Director of Marketing.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Creator Whose Work Decides Whether It Converts

In most companies, video people make things that look good and hope somebody tests them. Here, you're the person whose first 3 seconds decide whether a cold audience stops scrolling, and whose product clip decides whether a shopper believes what's on screen is what arrives in the box. When an ad drives outbound CTR but not orders, your read on where it broke — hook, promise, or landing experience, is the reason the next iteration wins. You'll build the judgment to tell shippable generated footage from footage a shopper quietly distrusts and the direct-response instinct for where proof lands in a 30-second ad and where it kills the momentum. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency turnaround time in front of you.

What You'll Need

Direct response portfolio
— You've created ads designed to drive action, not just entertain. Performance results are valued where available.
Character consistency work
— You can maintain coherent characters, environments and visual details across multiple generated shots.
AI video generation fluency
— Hands-on experience with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance or similar. You understand that different models solve different production problems.
Strong AI image-generation fundamentals
— Midjourney, Flux or similar tools for building controlled visual starting points and references.
Post-production expertise
— Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci or similar. You're comfortable with compositing, colour grading, clean-up and upscaling.
Audio proficiency
— AI voice synthesis, music and sound design for performance creative.
Direct-response judgment
— You understand hooks, pacing, problem/solution structure, proof, offers and calls to action.
Production speed
— You can create and iterate multiple assets without treating every piece like a weeks-long production.
Quality judgment
— You know when generated footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production and when the right decision is to regenerate it.

Good-to-Have

DTC or e-commerce performance marketing experience
Ads with measurable conversion results
Familiarity with creative testing frameworks
Experience creating video specifically for e-commerce product pages or other on-site conversion journeys

The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
Be the Owner:
We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
Execute with Urgency:
We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
Demand Excellence:
We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
Be AI-First:
Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
Go All-In:
When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits

Annual salary review every January

International team collaboration, 16+ nationalities in one office. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

jobs.description:
About the Role

FundingPips is looking for a Senior Brand Designer / Design Lead to lead the visual direction of FundingPips, manage the quality and development of our design team, and build new brands and visual identities from the ground up.
This is not simply an executional design role.
We are looking for someone who can take a business idea, product or brand with no existing visual identity and transform it into a complete, commercially relevant brand system — from initial creative direction and visual territory through to identity, typography, colour systems, graphic language, guidelines and rollout.
The role also requires a strong understanding of e-commerce and conversion-focused design. The successful candidate should understand how creative decisions influence customer behaviour across landing pages, product pages, checkout journeys, promotional campaigns and paid advertising.
Alongside developing new brands, this person will own and evolve the FundingPips visual identity, ensuring everything we produce is distinctive, consistent and commercially effective.
The role requires someone equally comfortable thinking strategically, directing other designers and remaining hands-on when required.

Key Responsibilities:

Brand Creation & Development

Develop complete brands and visual identities from scratch.
Translate business strategy, audience positioning and brand personality into a clear visual direction.
Conduct visual research, competitor analysis and category mapping before developing new identities.
Develop moodboards, visual territories and creative concepts during the early stages of brand development.
Create complete identity systems including:

Logos and brand marks
Typography systems
Colour palettes
Graphic language
Iconography
Image and photography direction
Illustration styles
Motion principles
Social media identity

Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

50 % Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle ZEINpharma-Produkte

Hochmoderne, neue Büroräume in Rüsselsheim mit ergonomischer, höhenverstellbarer Ausstattung

Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt vor der Tür und kostenlose Getränke

Up to AED 22,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base

Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support
Growth path
from here is Senior AI Video Creator → Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023:
In this role, tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Midjourney and Flux are part of the production workflow — not side experiments. AI gets you to footage faster; your judgment decides whether the hook works, the product looks real, the edit holds attention and the finished asset is ready to ship.

Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Video Creator, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. You will own AI video production across cold-traffic ads on Meta, TikTok and YouTube and product videos on Puffy.com, covering concept and script, image generation, motion, editing, compositing, colour and audio. This role exists to turn already-scaled media spend into creative that converts, building the production pipeline that carries a hook from script to shippable asset at volume without the craft slipping.

The Career Accelerator

You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.

The scope is scarce:
very few AI Video Creators get simultaneous ownership of video creative for both paid advertising and the product page. And a direct line to the Director of Marketing with no layers in between.
Your first 12 months:
build the prompt and reference library for character and material consistency. Produce direct-response ads at volume for Meta and TikTok cold prospecting, multiple concepts per week. Solve character consistency across shots, including AI-generated spokespeople delivering to camera. Produce realism-first product video for Puffy.com from real product photography. Get material behaviour right — foam that compresses under a hand and recovers on release, fabric that moves like fabric. Master the invisible edit, blending generated footage with stock and shot footage until the AI elements are indistinguishable. Read CTR, hold rates and drop-off points and iterate the hook against what audiences actually do. Shape the future of AI video at Puffy, where creative is the binding constraint on a media engine that is already scaled.

What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI video role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

1. Own the Entire Chain, Script to Shipped Asset

You concept it, generate it, cut it, score it, and ship it.
You design the visual worlds, control the motion, cut for retention, and layer the voiceover, music and sound design — no handoff, no queue, no waiting on someone else's render. You choose which model solves which production problem, and you decide when footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production, and when the right call is to regenerate.
The standard is performance, not applause. Every asset is a hypothesis: with the broader marketing team, you review CTR, hold rates, drop-off points and on-page conversion, iterate the hook, and bring your cuts into review with the Director of Marketing.

2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

3. Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.

4. Become the Creator Whose Work Decides Whether It Converts

In most companies, video people make things that look good and hope somebody tests them. Here, you're the person whose first 3 seconds decide whether a cold audience stops scrolling, and whose product clip decides whether a shopper believes what's on screen is what arrives in the box. When an ad drives outbound CTR but not orders, your read on where it broke — hook, promise, or landing experience, is the reason the next iteration wins. You'll build the judgment to tell shippable generated footage from footage a shopper quietly distrusts and the direct-response instinct for where proof lands in a 30-second ad and where it kills the momentum. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency turnaround time in front of you.

What You'll Need

Direct response portfolio
— You've created ads designed to drive action, not just entertain. Performance results are valued where available.
Character consistency work
— You can maintain coherent characters, environments and visual details across multiple generated shots.
AI video generation fluency
— Hands-on experience with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance or similar. You understand that different models solve different production problems.
Strong AI image-generation fundamentals
— Midjourney, Flux or similar tools for building controlled visual starting points and references.
Post-production expertise
— Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci or similar. You're comfortable with compositing, colour grading, clean-up and upscaling.
Audio proficiency
— AI voice synthesis, music and sound design for performance creative.
Direct-response judgment
— You understand hooks, pacing, problem/solution structure, proof, offers and calls to action.
Production speed
— You can create and iterate multiple assets without treating every piece like a weeks-long production.
Quality judgment
— You know when generated footage is strong enough to ship, when it needs post-production and when the right decision is to regenerate it.

Good-to-Have

DTC or e-commerce performance marketing experience
Ads with measurable conversion results
Familiarity with creative testing frameworks
Experience creating video specifically for e-commerce product pages or other on-site conversion journeys

The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
Be the Owner:
We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
Execute with Urgency:
We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
Demand Excellence:
We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
Be AI-First:
Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
Go All-In:
When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits

Up to AED 22,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
Annual salary review every January
Tax-free income
Annual return flight allowance to your home country
Parking allowance (up to AED 7,800 annually)

Life insurance & Personal Accident Insurance (24x monthly salary)

22 working days annual leave + UAE public holidays

UAE work visa sponsorship
International flights & airport transfers
14-day 4-star hotel accommodation

AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack
Premium office environment in Dubai Internet City
Up to $5,000 annual learning budget for courses and certifications
International team collaboration, 16+ nationalities in one office. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

End of Service Gratuity per UAE law
Puffy product discount up to 50%

Join TUI Musement as our Brand & AI Creative Designer, where you'll combine outstanding design craft with emerging AI technologies to create impactful brand campaigns, scalable creative systems and engaging customer experiences across global markets.

The role will be published until 5th of November.

About Our Offer

Personal benefits:
Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.

Flexible working:
Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.

A career to shape:
Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.

Broaden your network:
We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams

Community:
Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

You'll develop creative concepts and visual directions for integrated brand campaigns, translating audience insights, campaign objectives and brand strategy into compelling ideas and channel-ready creative solutions.
Creating and adapting assets across digital, social media, CRM, websites, retail environments, print and other customer touchpoints will be a key part of your role.
You'll help shape and evolve brand guidelines, creative frameworks and visual standards, making it easier for teams and markets to deliver consistent and effective brand experiences.
Using AI-assisted creative tools, you'll support ideation, visual exploration, prototyping and asset adaptation while applying strong creative judgement to ensure all outputs remain distinctive and brand-aligned.
You'll build scalable creative systems, templates and toolkits that enable efficient adaptation across markets, languages, formats and channels without compromising creative quality.
Working closely with content, campaign, video, production, commercial and product teams, you'll ensure creative ideas remain consistent and effective throughout delivery.
You'll present creative thinking with confidence, clearly articulating the rationale behind concepts, frameworks and design decisions to a variety of stakeholders.
By identifying opportunities to improve creative processes, brand application and AI-enabled workflows, you'll help make our creative output more consistent, scalable and future-ready.

You have proven experience in brand design, graphic design, campaign creation, art direction or creative development within either an agency or in-house environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English allow you to communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
Your portfolio demonstrates strong concept development and execution across multiple channels, formats and customer touchpoints.
You've successfully contributed to brand guidelines, design systems, campaign toolkits or similar creative frameworks that support consistency and scalability.
Strong design craft enables you to create high-quality work across layout, typography, visual hierarchy, imagery and art direction for both digital and print channels.

You can translate strategic objectives into compelling visual concepts and communicate your ideas through engaging storytelling and presentations.
Organised, proactive and collaborative, you're comfortable managing multiple briefs, stakeholder groups, feedback rounds and deadlines while maintaining creative excellence.
Experience working across multilingual, multi-market or matrix organisations would be advantageous.
